title: You sneak you get nuked
description: Everytime you press shift you explode and freakin' DIE
body:
Do **YOU** want to **explode**?

Everytime you press shift you'll explode.... Actually you can rebind the key to anything you want, and I've added 4 extras keys for it in case you'd like to bind multiple to different keys I guess.

This is a joke mod and aimed at people wanting to have a sort of fun challenge.
### I HIGHLY discourage using this on worlds you want to keep etc etc..
Your choice.
